name: Nexa Live Chat — AI/FAQ First Contact, Agent Queue & Capacity
author: NexaCMS
description: Persistent site-wide chat bubble. Direct JSON API endpoint, FAQ/systematic or AI first contact, bulk FAQ import (CSV/TSV/JSON/text with followups column), smart suggestions on both ends (visitor starter/follow-up chips from hand-picked, auto-related or AI follow-ups; agent suggested replies that insert for editing), automatic escalation to a human queue, per-agent concurrent-chat capacity, agent console with reply-to-take-over, floating admin alert bubble (badge/sound/desktop alerts), FAQs, history and settings.
